text: 当地时间7月31日，罗马尼亚政府宣布，受近期干旱和河流流量下降影响，罗马尼亚发电量下降，在整个8月期间全国进入警戒状态。罗马尼亚国内燃气、燃煤发电厂将以最大产能运行，同时投入光伏、风力发电和储能，并从有过剩产能国家进口电力，以缓解当前局面。（央视新闻）
text_en: On July 31 local time, the Romanian government announced that due to recent drought and falling river flows, power generation has declined, prompting a nationwide alert for the entire month of August. Domestic gas and coal-fired plants will operate at maximum capacity, while solar, wind, and storage capacity will be deployed, and electricity will be imported from countries with surplus capacity to ease the situation. (CCTV)
